provisions_read: DOB PW1 User Guide p. 14, sections 12B and 12C (E4, as quoted by the owner research)
exceptions_considered: A filing's proposed total can be building-only if its zoning section lists the retained building separately; only the filled PW1 section 12 and the ZD1 show which.
Total construction floor area (45,388 sq ft) is a different measure from zoning floor area.
The 2022 A1 total (39,772, disapproved) and the NB total (39,934, permitted) are different filings, not one revision.
The 2017 job 421199072 (14,150) predates the March 2017 tax-lot split.
meaning_and_applicability.reading: If the PW1 instruction was followed, 39,934 sq ft is the zoning lot's whole proposed zoning floor area, including the retained lot 1 building; subtracting lot 1's 9,100 sq ft again would count it twice. That is not established: the filled PW1/ZD1 has not been read, and the guide quote has not been re-read by the orchestrator.

conclusion.interpretation: Whether 39,934 sq ft includes the retained lot 1 building is unknown; the PW1 guide suggests it should, which is a reason not to subtract lot 1 again, not a finding.
conditions: Remaining capacity cannot be computed while the scope of 39,934 sq ft is unknown.

worked_example.inputs: The owner research's hypothetical, not a finding: zoning lot 20,000 sq ft x FAR 2.0 = 40,000 sq ft.
worked_example.expected: If 39,934 is the whole zoning lot's total: 40,000 - 39,934 = 66 sq ft. If it is building-only and lot 1's 9,100 is separate: 40,000 - 49,034 = -9,034 sq ft. Neither is shown; existing zoning floor area reads unknown when a block filing mentions a zoning lot, and remaining capacity reads 'Not confirmed'.
worked_example.basis: Arithmetic on the filed figures; owner rule D-090-R038 (remaining capacity reads Not confirmed until the zoning lot and existing zoning floor area are verified).
worked_example.prepared_by: orchestrator (Claude Code session 01TpXJN7), 2026-10-11; worked from the law text, not from a program run; not professionally checked

regression_cases: A block filing that mentions a zoning lot sets the DOB figure aside (existing behaviour; services/api/tests/profile/test_existing_floor_area_benchmark.py).
Unused floor area reports 'Not confirmed', never a number (services/api/app/profile/parity/unused_floor_area.py).
dependency_assessment: The code already avoids this double count: existing_floor_area.resolve sets aside a zoning-lot-scoped DOB figure and records zoning_lot_scope as not established; parity.unused_floor_area computes no remaining figure. No change is needed for this record; any future remaining-capacity calculation must read this record first.
